# Clavis Encrypt 3.15.0

## 🆕 Team folders

- Share one encrypted folder with your family or office in OneDrive, Google Drive, Dropbox or a shared network drive. Everyone opens it with their own Clavis ID: no shared password.
- Open **Sharing → Team folders**, press **Create a team folder…**, pick the folder and add members. Then share the folder with them in your cloud service, and they choose **Join a team folder…**. Check each other's fingerprint before adding or joining.
- **Add files…** puts encrypted copies in the folder. With **Open** (Clavis Pro), a file opens in its usual program and is saved back for the team when you save. If two people save the same file at once, both versions are kept.
- Owners can add and remove members at any time. A removed person can't open new or changed files. Remove their access to the folder in your cloud service too, as they may still have copies of older files.
- Files your cloud hasn't downloaded yet show as **Not downloaded yet**, and opening one downloads it first.
- Creating a team folder and adding members is part of **Clavis Premium**, up to 3 team folders per licence. Joining a team folder, adding files and saving copies is free.

## Find sensitive files

- **Find sensitive files now recognises documents from many countries.** By content, it recognises:
  - the machine-readable lines on passports and ID cards from any country;
  - IBANs;
  - bank statements and payslips with English, French or German headings;
  - US Social Security numbers and W-2, 1099 and 1040 forms;
  - UK National Insurance numbers, P60 and P45;
  - French social security numbers and German tax IDs.

  It also looks for more file names in English, French and German. It can still miss some documents.
- **Find sensitive files is now part of Clavis Pro.** Encrypting, decrypting and shredding files stay free, with the same encryption as the paid plans.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now), or download the new installer from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.
- **Microsoft Store:** the Store updates it automatically.
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
